title: Early Planet Formation in Embedded Disks (eDisk). XVII. A Compact but Structured Keplerian Disk and Large-scale Streamers Revealed in the Class I Protostellar System IRAS 04169+2702
question: Does the Class I protostar IRAS 04169+2702 host a Keplerian disk with substructure, and what is the nature of the large-scale spiral structures around it (streamers vs outflow)?

data.bands: Band 6 (1.3 mm); VLA Q, K, C

what.value: Bolometric luminosity 1.4 Lsun and Tbol 161 K

evidence.quote: re-calculated its bolometric luminosity and temperature to be 1.4 $L_{\odot}$ and 161 K, respectively

what.value: Dust temperature scaling relation T=43 K (L/Lsun)^0.25 (R/50 au)^-0.5

recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, iterative phase and amplitude self-calibration on SB then SBLB, tclean imaging of SB, SBLB, LB-only

recipe.goal: Measure continuum disk size, inclination, peaks
recipe.method: Elliptical Gaussian fitting; inclination from axis ratio cos^-1(min/maj); separate Gaussian fits of two peaks
Optically thin isothermal dust mass formula with kappa=2.25 cm2/g at 225 GHz, T=20 K and 61 K, gas-to-dust 100
assumptions: gas-to-dust ratio 100; d=156 pc; optically thin

recipe.goal: Proper-motion correct VLA vs ALMA and fit radio SED
recipe.method: Proper motion from I04166 imfit centers applied to I04169; two power-law (dust + free-free) fit of 1.3 mm to 6 cm fluxes
SLAM ridge and edge methods on LB-only PV diagrams of 12CO, 13CO, C18O along major axis, high-velocity ranges only, single power-law rotation curve
key_parameters: Vsys 6.9 km/s, inclination 43 deg; thresholds 5σ (12CO, C18O), 6σ (13CO)
assumptions: p fixed to 0.5 for 12CO mass; final mass is mean of ridge and edge

recipe.method: Moment 0/1/2/8/9 maps and channel maps; compare velocity dispersion of 12CO, 13CO, C18O

evidence.quote: for the LB-only image, they are 0.22$''$ $\times$ 0.16$''$ (34 au $\times$ 25 au) and 140$\ensuremath{^\circ}$, respectively
estimate the disk inclination angle to be 43$\ensuremath{^\circ}$

answer_key.quantity: Projected separation of two continuum peaks

evidence.quote: The projected separation of the two peaks is 0.11$''$ (17 au).
the dust masses of the protostellar disk are derived to be 67 and 18 $M_{\ensuremath{\oplus}}$, respectively
the dust temperature of I04169 is derived to be 61 K
0.766 $\pm$ 0.059 $M_{\odot}$ in the ridge method and 2.007 $\pm$ 0.071 $M_{\odot}$ in the edge method
0.766 $\pm$ 0.059 $M_{\odot}$ in the ridge method and 2.007 $\pm$ 0.071 $M_{\odot}$ in the edge method
The index $p$ is derived as 1.012 $\pm$ 0.058 in the ridge method and 0.933 $\pm$ 0.074 in the edge method.
The Keplerian radius is expected to be somewhere between 18 and 24 au.
we use 6.9 km s$^{-1}$ as the systemic velocity in this paper

tclean cell size, image size, deconvolver, masks and thresholds
SLAM fitting settings (PV cut width, thresholds for ridge/edge, outer radius range)

score_reason: Public ALMA data and scripts with clear numeric results, but key imaging, SLAM and SED fit settings are deferred to companion papers or unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Public eDisk data, public scripts, SLAM public, and numeric results (mass, spectral index, dust mass) available.
